description: Source code for LocationService implementation, including classes for geographic data handling, network communication, and location probing within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace.

classes.name: IGeography
classes.description: Interface for geographic data, providing methods to access country, city, region, timezone, latitude, longitude, IP, and update status.

classes.name: Geography
classes.description: Implementation of IGeography, managing geographic data with JSON serialization, including methods to access geographic properties and set location.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: Represents a geographic response, implementing IGeography, encapsulating IP, ping status, and geographic data, with methods to access geographic properties and update location.

classes.name: DomainConstructor
classes.description: Structure defining a domain name, its length, and a factory function to create IGeography instances.

classes.name: LocationService
classes.description: Main class providing location services, including probing remote servers, handling network communication, and managing geographic data.

methods.name: LocationService::Probe
methods.description: Initiates a location probe to a remote URL with retries and interval control.

methods.name: LocationService::Stop
methods.description: Stops ongoing location activities and closes connections.

methods.name: LocationService::LinkBody
methods.description: Links the response body to the response object if the status is OK.

methods.name: LocationService::Received
methods.description: Handles received response, updates geographic info, and triggers callback.

methods.name: LocationService::Send
methods.description: Sends a request over the network.

methods.name: LocationService::StateChange
methods.description: Handles state changes in the network link, triggering request sending or closing.

methods.name: LocationService::Dispatch
methods.description: Manages network probing, retries, and fallback to IPv4 if IPv6 fails.

methods.name: LocationService::IsSupported
methods.description: Checks if a remote node URL is supported for location probing.
